frame: Y-up in the game. The rig is in place; heading, speed and depth come from the game.

noticeability.silhouette: pale underside and dark dorsal with wings held wide: reads at 90 m against both sand and deep water
noticeability.shadow: a soft dark blob the size of the wingspan on the seabed while altitude is under 12 m, fading out by 20 m
noticeability.sound: a wing-beat cue on every flap (every 2.4 s cruising, every 1.1 s powered), spatialised, audible to 60 m
noticeability.event_cues: a splash and a ripple ring on breach; a brief whoosh when it bolts
noticeability.frequency_target: a manta is in view (within 90 m) about a fifth of the time an explorer is in the lagoon; a breach about every 6 to 10 min per manta while explorers are around

integration.status: spec only, not implemented in the game
integration.owner: the local Claude Code session in the game repository
steps: Replace the procedural manta mesh with assets/manta/Manta.glb (one skinned mesh, 13 bones, 10 clips).
Drive the state machine above from the game's own world (depth, waypoints, player position, bloom zones).
Keep the clips in place: apply the game's heading and speed to the root, never bake motion into a clip.
Hook the event cues (splash, ripple, sound) to the breach and flee transitions.
Tune the numbers in this file first, then copy them into the game's data.
